    color = next(iter(shared))

    return [[3 if left[r][c] == color and right[r][c] == color else color
             for c in range(n)] for r in range(h)]

from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # The uniform center column divides two equal-size panels.
    sep = min((c for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1),
              key=lambda c: abs(c - w // 2))
    n = sep
    left = [row[:n] for row in grid]
    right = [row[sep + 1:sep + 1 + n] for row in grid]
    shared = set(x for row in left for x in row) & set(x for row in right for x in row)
    color = next(iter(shared))
    bg_l = Counter(x for row in left for x in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    bg_r = Counter(x for row in right for x in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    if bg_l == color and bg_r == color:
        # Shared background in both panels: encode any non-background cell.
        return [[2 if left[r][c] != color or right[r][c] != color else 3
                 for c in range(n)] for r in range(h)]
    # Otherwise mark aligned occurrences of the shared color.
    return [[3 if left[r][c] == color and right[r][c] == color else color
             for c in range(n)] for r in range(h)]
